notes.title: Skykipelago Devlog 07.06.2024
notes.content:
[b]Devlog for Skykipelago – A Chill Building Strategy Game in the Sky[/b]

Hello, Sky Builders!

We're back this week with another portion of behind-the-scenes stuff from Skykipelago development. Let's get into it!

Recently, we've been working hard on our particle system. It has two main purposes:
[list]
[*] to look beautiful;
[*] to highlight important info for the player.
[/list]
It's still WIP but you can see the results below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948741/78e2dadb41770b188294ab2e8f591f81c3f7d790.png[/img]

These particles highlight the 'moar buildingsss' button. Whenever you run out of buildings in your queue, this particle emitter should turn on, saying 'click me for more buildings'.

Let us know what you think below.

[b]Have a happy weekend,
Cheers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1980460/Skykipelago/
